name: 77328 · Cleveland, TX
findings: ZIP 77328 (Cleveland) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77328 (Cleveland) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
